trust_decision.summary: The SSE encoder decides whether caller-supplied id/event values may be emitted (must contain no line terminator) and how comment/data values are split into lines; at the pinned commit it recognises only LF, while the SSE parser (and the spec) also treat CR and CRLF as line ends, so a bare CR splits one field into a new field/event.

landing_point.why: The summary names cow_sse:event/1; its body at src/cow_sse.erl:288-296 composes every field builder, and the checks sit a few lines below.

fix_sites.entry_point: cow_sse:event/1, cow_sse:events/1 (public API, map key id)
fix_sites.module_kind: core encoder (same module as landing point)

fix_sites.entry_point: cow_sse:event/1, cow_sse:events/1 (public API, map key event; iodata or atom)
fix_sites.module_kind: core encoder (same module as landing point)

fix_sites.entry_point: cow_sse:event/1, cow_sse:events/1 (public API, map keys data via src/cow_sse.erl:320 and comment via src/cow_sse.erl:299)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only weak: a solver fixing data/id could argue the comment field (src/cow_sse.erl:299, prefix_lines with empty prefix) is ignored by clients, but it goes through the same helper so it is fixed together.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-line data (and comments) must keep being split into several 'data:' lines rather than rejected, and CRLF must count as ONE line break (splitting on CR and LF separately inserts an empty data line and breaks build/parse round-trip); the fix diff's identity tests check exactly this (fix.diff:87-110).

O7_producer.where: src/cow_sse.erl:329-331 (prefix_lines line splitter shared by data and comment)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a retry field accepting iodata or a binary in addition to integer, emitted without a line-terminator check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The event() type (src/cow_sse.erl:40-46) already accepts iodata for every other field; a maintainer loosening retry to binary for convenience would plausibly copy the event_id shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second streaming encoder (e.g. an event_stream/2 or chunk helper that pre-joins fields with a hand-rolled LF split) in another module
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Only realistic as a planted second implementation; the pinned tree has no other SSE emitter (only src/cow_sse.erl matches *sse*).

O9_family: CRLF / line-terminator injection in a text event-stream serializer (CWE-93), encoder/parser line-ending differential

O10_build.toolchain: Erlang/OTP + erlang.mk (make); eunit tests inline under -ifdef(TEST)
O10_build.project_tests: Inline eunit tests in src/cow_sse.erl:154-281 (parser) and src/cow_sse.erl:333-349 (event_test, smoke only, no assertions on output)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add \r to the id/event nomatch checks and split data on [<<"\r">>, <<"\n">>] (no CRLF pattern), which turns CRLF into an extra empty data line.

out_of_scope_notes: cow_http1:request/4, response/3, headers/1 (src/cow_http1.erl:326-339) emit header names/values with no CR/LF check — different protection and sink (HTTP header CRLF), not this advisory.
cow_multipart:part/2 (src/cow_multipart.erl:442-450) emits part headers with no CR/LF check — different sink.
SSE spec says an id containing NUL should be ignored by clients; event_id (src/cow_sse.erl:303-305) does not reject NUL — not a line-splitting issue.
Downstream users of cow_sse (e.g. Cowboy) are other repositories.
